explanationMd: Find two numbers whose product is −12 and sum is 1. They are 4 and −3, giving the stated factors. Expanding produces x² + (4 − 3)x − 12, checking both coefficients.

distractorRationale.a: This produces a middle coefficient of −1.
distractorRationale.d: This produces a middle coefficient of 4.
distractorRationale.e: This gives a positive constant term.
distractorRationale.c: This also gives a positive constant and a different middle term.
